claim: Every A in the source Gamma(Z^d) has trace at most 2d-1.
remaining_gap: No classification of matrices below the trace ceiling.

claim: Every symmetric integer matrix of trace 2d-1 is maximal in the full source Gamma(Z^d).
remaining_gap: Other maximal elements, rationality and isolation remain uncontrolled.

claim: A diagonal matrix has an integer separable quadratic-growth representative of Laplacian at most 2d-1 iff the sum of ceilings of its diagonal entries is at most 2d-1.
remaining_gap: General diagonal representatives need not be separable; no such equivalence was proved.

claim: Gamma(Z^d) is downward closed and each member is dominated by a maximal member.
remaining_gap: Does not identify the resulting maximal member.

claim: Addition of a symmetric integer trace-zero matrix preserves Gamma(Z^d) and its maximal elements.
remaining_gap: No classification within a period cell.

claim: An integer representative with a full-rank affine translation cocycle has rational Hessian; denominators divide the determinant of its period basis.
remaining_gap: No proof that every maximal element has this cocycle.

claim: For every d>=3 there exists a maximal member of the source Gamma(Z^d) which is not an integer matrix.
remaining_gap: The explicit half-integral A_d is admitted but not proved maximal. Its maximal extension is existential and is not proved irrational or isolated.

checks.domination_obstruction: A positive-semidefinite increment has nonnegative integer diagonal of trace at most 1, so a zero row conflicts with the half-integer off-diagonal.

claim: The corrected period-two affine-cocycle search produced 23 exact-verified witness certificates among 112 cases for 14 half-integral matrices in d=3, threshold 5.
remaining_gap: No numerical infeasibility is used as global exclusion; no maximality is inferred from these finite cases.
